=== ROA #1 @ 35833 ===
:#183449;padding:0 34px 0 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;max-width:100%}
.analysis-chart-wrap{border:1px solid #e8eff2;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,#fbfdfd 100%);padding:14px 15px 8px}
.analysis-chart{display:block;width:100%;max-height:330px;height:auto;overflow:visible}
.analysis-chart text{font-family:inherit;fill:#758a9b;font-size:12px;font-weight:550}
.analysis-chart .analysis-grid{stroke:#e5edf0;stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:4 6}
.analysis-chart .analysis-line{stroke:#0b9386;stroke-width:3;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.analysis-chart .analysis-dot{fill:#0c968a;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3}
.analysis-chart .analysis-label{fill:#153f4c;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
.analysis-chart .analysis-year{font-size:12px;font-weight:750;fill:#526d80}
.analysis-periods{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:13px}
.analysis-period{background:#f4f8fa;border:1px solid #e3ecef;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 13px;min-width:140px;flex:1}
.analysis-period small{display:block;color:#758b9b;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:4px}
.analysis-period strong{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#17384a;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.analysis-period .missing{font-size:12px;color:#778b97;font-weight:500}
.analysis-explainer{font-size:12px;color:#708795;margin:14px 0 0;line-height:1.65}
.analysis-explainer b{color:#25475a}
@media(max-width:1050px){.analysis-feature-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:690px){.analysis-feature-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.analysis-feature{padding:17px}.analysis-trend{padding:16px}.analysis-trend-head{display:block}.analysis-select{max-width:100%;margin-top:14px}.analysis-period{min-width:calc(50% - 8px)}}

/* AUREL metric tiles: same restrained design as ROA / ROE / CIR cards. */
.grid.metrics>.metric{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:137px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #dae5ed;box-shadow:0 9px 24px rgba(17,48,70,.035);padding:21px 22px 19px;background:#fff}
.grid.metrics>.metric:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:3px;background:#15977f}
.grid.metrics>.metric:nth-child(2):before{background:#244e70}
.grid.metrics>.metric:nth-child(3):before{background:#83b5bc}
.grid.metrics>.metric:nth-child(4):before{background:#547c9f}
.grid.metrics>.metric .metric-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#6a8094}
.grid.metrics>.metric>strong{font-size:30px;line-height:1.22;color:#1c3449;letter-spacing:-.9px}
.grid.metrics>.metric .metric-foot{font-size:11.5px;color:#8395a5}
.ai-top-features{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px}
.ai-feature{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%,#fbfdfd 100%);border:1px solid #dce7ee;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(17,48,70,.04);border-radius:16px;padding:18px 20px;min-width:0}
.ai-feature:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;right:0;left:0;height:3px;background:#15977f}
.ai-feature:nth-child(2):before{background:#244e70}.ai-feature:nth-child(3):before{background:#83b5bc}
.ai-feature .label{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.2px;font-weight:750;color:#607a8d;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.ai-feature .label svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:#86a4b8;flex-shrink:0}
.ai-feature strong{display:block;font-size:18px;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.4px;color:#1c3449;margin:11px 0 6px}
.ai-feature p{font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.65;color:#8798a6;margin:0}
.ai-connect{border-radius:13px;padding:12px 14px;margin-top:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f3faf8 0%,#eef7f5 100%);border:1px solid #deece9;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ai-connect .ai-connect-status{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#416474}.ai-connect .button{min-height:35px;padding:8px 11px}
@media(max-width:980px){.ai-top-features{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Phong cách thẻ: chỉ Nguồn dữ liệu và trang Giám sát chỉ tiêu. */
.dataset-cards .dataset-card,.monitor-overview .monitor-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfe9ef;border-radius:17px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(19,48,69,.045);min-height:125px;padding:19px 18px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.dataset-cards .dataset-card:before,.monitor-overview .monitor-card:before{position:absolute;content:'';left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:3px;background:#129b88}
.dataset-cards .dataset-card:nth-child(2):before,.monitor-overview .monitor-card:nth-child(2):before{background:#204b70}
.dataset-cards .dataset-card:nth-child(3):before,.monitor-overview .monitor-card:nth-child(3):before{background:#84b5bb}
.dataset-cards .dataset-card:nth-child(4):before,.monitor-overview .monitor-card:nth-child(4):before{background:#b59d7b}
.dataset-cards .dataset-card small,.monitor-overview .monitor-card small{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;color:#6a8195;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin:0;line-height:1.45}
.dataset-cards .dataset-card strong,.monitor-overview .monitor-card strong{font-size:29px;letter-spacing:-.9px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:800;color:#193449;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.monitor-overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin:0 0 20px}

""!important;
  position:absolute!important;
  inset:0!important;
  border-radius:18px!important;
  padding:1.5px!important;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#29d3ff,#31e0b8,#5aa8ff)!important;
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0)!important;
  -webkit-mask-composite:xor!important;
  mask-composite:exclude!important;
  pointer-events:none!important;
  z-index:50!important;
  opacity:.95!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(41,211,255,.10)!important;
}

body:not(.aurel-dark-theme) .aurel-r139-full-led::after{
  opacity:.82!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(41,211,255,.08)!important;
}
</style>
<script id="AUREL_R139_FULL_BORDER_LED_METRICS_JS">
(function(){
  function norm(v){
    return String(v||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
  }

  function validCard(el){
    if(!el || el===document.body) return false;
    var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    var t=norm(el.textContent);
    return r.width>=220 && r.width<=620 && r.height>=120 && r.height<=360 && t.length<520;
  }

  function nearestCard(el){
    if(!el) return null;
    var preferred=el.closest(".metric,.card,.panel,.analysis-feature,.analysis-card");
    if(preferred && validCard(preferred)) return preferred;
    var cur=el;
    for(var i=0;i<8 && cur && cur!==document.body;i++,cur=cur.parentElement){
      if(validCard(cur)) return cur;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function mark(label){
    document.querySelectorAll("body *").forEach(function(el){
      if(norm(el.textContent)!==label) return;
      var card=nearestCard(el);
      if(card) card.classList.add("aurel-r139-full-led");
    });
  }

  function apply(){
    document.querySelectorAll(".aurel-r139-full-led").forEach(function(el){
      el.classList.remove("aurel-r139-full-led");
    });
    mark("ROA - Hiệu quả tài sản");
    mark("ROE - Hiệu quả vốn");
    mark("CIR - Chi phí / Thu nhập");
  }

  var queued=false;
  function schedule(){
    if(queued) return;
    queued=true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      queued=false;
      apply();
    });
  }

  if(document.readyState==="loading"){
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",schedule,{once:true});
  }else{
    schedule();
  }

  var root=document.getElementById("root")||document.body;
  new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(root,{childList:true,subtree:true});
  document.addEventListener("click",function(){setTimeout(apply,40)},true);
})();
</script>
</body></html>

=== CIR #2 @ 1138093 ===
border-radius:18px!important;
  padding:1.5px!important;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#29d3ff,#31e0b8,#5aa8ff)!important;
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0)!important;
  -webkit-mask-composite:xor!important;
  mask-composite:exclude!important;
  pointer-events:none!important;
  z-index:50!important;
  opacity:.95!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(41,211,255,.10)!important;
}

body:not(.aurel-dark-theme) .aurel-r139-full-led::after{
  opacity:.82!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(41,211,255,.08)!important;
}
</style>
<script id="AUREL_R139_FULL_BORDER_LED_METRICS_JS">
(function(){
  function norm(v){
    return String(v||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
  }

  function validCard(el){
    if(!el || el===document.body) return false;
    var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    var t=norm(el.textContent);
    return r.width>=220 && r.width<=620 && r.height>=120 && r.height<=360 && t.length<520;
  }

  function nearestCard(el){
    if(!el) return null;
    var preferred=el.closest(".metric,.card,.panel,.analysis-feature,.analysis-card");
    if(preferred && validCard(preferred)) return preferred;
    var cur=el;
    for(var i=0;i<8 && cur && cur!==document.body;i++,cur=cur.parentElement){
      if(validCard(cur)) return cur;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function mark(label){
    document.querySelectorAll("body *").forEach(function(el){
      if(norm(el.textContent)!==label) return;
      var card=nearestCard(el);
      if(card) card.classList.add("aurel-r139-full-led");
    });
  }

  function apply(){
    document.querySelectorAll(".aurel-r139-full-led").forEach(function(el){
      el.classList.remove("aurel-r139-full-led");
    });
    mark("ROA - Hiệu quả tài sản");
    mark("ROE - Hiệu quả vốn");
    mark("CIR - Chi phí / Thu nhập");
  }

  var queued=false;
  function schedule(){
    if(queued) return;
    queued=true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      queued=false;
      apply();
    });
  }

  if(document.readyState==="loading"){
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",schedule,{once:true});
  }else{
    schedule();
  }

  var root=document.getElementById("root")||document.body;
  new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(root,{childList:true,subtree:true});
  document.addEventListener("click",function(){setTimeout(apply,40)},true);
})();
</script>
</body></html>
